propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state the close precheck requires a MERGED commit, when it actually accepts any commit reachable from HEAD, merged or not
The close precheck is conditional on file_impact being recorded and the completion-verification gate being enabled, not unconditional as the docs imply
AGENTS.md omits documentation of rebar transition --ref, the sanctioned way to close a stacked story against its own commit while the worktree stays at the epic tip
The precheck accepts a referencing commit for the ticket or any transitive descendant in the subtree, not just the single ticket
Land-before-close ordering is enforced by the Verified +1 policy rule, not by the precheck mechanism
The --ref flag retargets completion verification and signature to a specific commit, but does not narrow the referencing-commit scan, which always scans HEAD's full history
